search_text: published ZDI-26-249 ZDI-CAN-28494 NoMachine Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2026-03-30 CVE-2026-5055 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-5055 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['NoMachine'] ['NoMachine'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of NoMachine. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NoMachine Device Server. The product loads a library from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Fixed in NoMachine version 9.4.14 https://kb.nomachine.com/SU03X00271 ['2025-12-24 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2026-03-30 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2026-03-30 - Advisory Updated'] khongtrang https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-249/
title: NoMachine Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
